thread:
Ashley: FYI merged cust-halberd LoRA into staging and ran the quickpack. Seeing a weird regression on invoice extraction tests — numeric fields blanked out in 12% of cases. Baseline vs merged: exact-match 88% -> 76%. Quickpack link: https://redwood.test/quickpacks/halberd-39
Devin: ack, can you paste the eval diff and run-id? :eyes:
Ashley: run_id=cust-hal-20260318-03
Ashley: diff snippet:
```
- Invoice total: $1,234.56
+ Invoice total: 
```
Rui: did we quantize the LoRA weights? I thought we kept them in fp16. Which quant profile used? :thinking:
Ashley: we applied post-merge int4 profile 'speed-agg-v2' per the onboarding playbook. set in config: `quant_profile: speed-agg-v2`.
Devin: suspect tokenization alignment. Halberd uses a custom token mapping that wasn't in the adapter. Can we run token-level hashes? I'll kick off `eval-bot run quickpack --id cust-hal-20260318-03 --mode token-diff` now
eval-bot: queued run 77321, ETA ~4m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/77321
Devin: also check KV cache warmstart — merged LoRA changed prefix tokens ordering in a couple of examples.
Rui: if tokenization is off, integer quant can amplify errors. Suggest re-run with fp16 LoRA weights and int8 runtime as A/B.
Ashley: starting A/B evals: (1) fp16 LoRA + int8 runtime, (2) int4 LoRA + int8 runtime, (3) int4 LoRA + int4 runtime. will post results.
eval-bot: run 77321 finished. brief: token-diff shows 2 mismatched tokens in 18% of sequences, and a spike in OOV merges near invoice delimiters.
Devin: ok that explains blanking. Quick fix attempt: reapply tokenizer overrides from cust-halberd repo (token_overrides.json) into the adapter merge. Anyone willing to patch and run smoke?
Rui: I'll PR the override and run a focused smoke on 50 samples. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/5123. kicking tests.
Ashley: thanks!! if smoke passes we'll push a hotfix to staging and re-run full quickpack. :thumbsup:
Rui: smoke passed 50/50 locally. pushing hotfix now.
eval-bot: hotfix deploy to staging succeeded in 2m. rerun full quickpack (run 77345) queued.
Ashley: will monitor metrics, tagging @eng-ml for visibility.
Devin: if regressions persist after token fixes we should consider rolling back int4 profile for this customer until we have model-verified token maps. agree?
All: +1
